provenance: Synthetic explicit human inputs; never provider defaults.

items.title: Retry controls are undefined
items.description: The design does not define the retry budget, backoff limits, or automatic-processing stop condition for ambiguous provider responses.
items.recommended_change: Document a bounded retry budget, exponential-backoff limits, and the stop condition before another provider submission.

items.title: Regional failover evidence is missing
items.description: The warm standby design has neither a scheduled exercise nor a measured recovery result.
items.recommended_change: Schedule the regional exercise and record measured recovery results against the draft targets.

items.title: Routing-record retention lacks approval
items.description: The proposed 30-day routing-record retention period has not received formal governance confirmation.
items.recommended_change: Obtain and record governance approval for the retention period before release readiness.

items.title: Schedule and document the regional failover exercise
